description: This file defines policies and functions related to control UI authentication, device identity enforcement, and role-based access control within a gateway server context.

methods.name: resolveControlUiAuthPolicy
methods.description: Determines the control UI authentication policy based on input parameters and configuration.

methods.name: shouldSkipControlUiPairing
methods.description: Decides whether to skip pairing for control UI based on policy, role, and auth mode.

methods.name: isTrustedProxyControlUiOperatorAuth
methods.description: Checks if the current context involves a trusted proxy operator authentication.

methods.name: shouldClearUnboundScopesForMissingDeviceIdentity
methods.description: Determines if unbound scopes should be cleared when device identity is missing.

methods.name: evaluateMissingDeviceIdentity
methods.description: Evaluates and returns decision on device identity enforcement based on various parameters.
